prompt: A resident finds visible powder on dry clothes after using the liquid compartment. What should the resident check first?
promptZh: 住戶用了液體洗劑槽，發現乾衣物上有可見的洗衣粉。住戶應先檢查什麼？

options.text: Whether the load was below the limit printed on the door
options.zh: 衣物重量是否低於門上載量上限
options.whyZh: 載量上限是厚重衣物的規定，並非可見粉末的第一項檢查。

options.text: Whether the machine allows a larger load with Extra Rinse
options.zh: 用額外漂洗是否可多放衣物
options.whyZh: 額外漂洗不改變可放的衣物量，而且問題是乾衣粉末。

options.text: Whether the divider was left up for powder
options.zh: 使用洗衣粉時隔板是否留在上方
options.whyZh: 乾衣仍有粉末先查洗劑盒；用粉時，隔板應在上方。

options.text: Whether a water-supply warning was reported to the desk
options.zh: 是否已向服務櫃檯回報供水警示
options.whyZh: 文中只說實際發生供水警示才回報，情境沒有警示。

explanationZh: 乾衣仍有粉末先查洗劑盒；用粉時，隔板應在上方。
evidence: If you can see undissolved detergent on otherwise dry clothing, however, check the detergent drawer first. | Leave the divider up if you use powder.

vocabulary.note: 此處指洗劑槽內可滑動的隔板。

difficultyRationale: 區別滑感與乾衣可見粉末，從洗劑盒的說明找真正可查的部位。
